changes.title: Siege hurry
items: Animals marching on a soundsystem now hurry there at half their running speed, instead of strolling
Owls, ravens, bats, and charging animals like elk, rams and hedgehogs now land and attack a soundsystem properly instead of swooping or charging past it

changes.title: Letters wake sleepers
items: Letters wake napping animals: a 💌 that reaches a sleeper wakes it and counts, from anywhere, instead of flying through it

changes.title: Home guard
items: Animals you park in the home area now guard the whole home area: they go for any wild or enraged animal anywhere in it
